caption: Korean Japgokbap (잡곡밥) — Multigrain Rice An easy way to add more whole grains, fiber, and texture to your rice—and perfect for meal prepping! 💛 🌾 You’ll need: • 1 cup @Kim'C Market Organic 5 Colored Rice (Use link in bio under My Favorites or use code BUSYMAMAEASYBITES for $10 off)  • 2 cups short or medium-grain white rice • Filtered water Wash the 5 colored rice about 3 times, then soak for 30 minutes to help soften the outer layer of the grains. Add the white rice and wash everything together 3–4 more times, until the water runs mostly clear. Transfer to your rice cooker and add filtered water. I use the Korean hand method—place your hand flat over the rice and add water up to the knuckles where your fingers meet your palm. Cook on the multigrain setting (mine takes about 45 minutes), until the grains are tender. Fluff and mix! 🍚 To freeze: Scoop into ½-cup portions—I use a muffin tray—and freeze for a few hours before transferring to a labeled freezer bag. To reheat: Place a portion in a bowl, sprinkle with a little water, cover with a damp paper towel, and microwave until piping hot all the way through.  Such an easy staple to have ready for busy nights! 🙌🏼 #Easyrecipe #Freezerprep #Mealprep #Koreanfood #koreanfoodlovers☺️🍶🍲🍜🍣
